import sys

MOD = 1000000007

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.N = size
        self.m = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
        for i in range(size):
            self.m[i][i] = 1

    def multiply(self, b):
        result = Matrix(self.N)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.N):
                sum_val = 0
                for k in range(self.N):
                    sum_val += self.m[i][k] * b.m[k][j]
                result.m[i][j] = sum_val % MOD
        return result

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    k = int(input_data[1])

    # Initialize M[0][i]
    M = [[None for _ in range(k)] for _ in range(71)]
    for i in range(k):
        M[0][i] = Matrix(k + 1)
        for j in range(k + 1):
            M[0][i].m[i][j] = 1

    power = [0] * 100
    power[0] = 1
    power[1] = k
    lg = 2
    while power[lg - 1] <= n // k:
        power[lg] = power[lg - 1] * k
        lg += 1

    for i in range(1, lg):
        M[i][0] = Matrix(k + 1)
        for j in range(1, k):
            M[i][j] = M[i - 1][j - 1].multiply(M[i][j - 1])
        cpro = Matrix(k + 1)
        for j in range(k - 1, -1, -1):
            cpro = cpro.multiply(M[i - 1][j])
            M[i][j] = M[i][j].multiply(cpro)

    ans = Matrix(k + 1)
    cc = 0
    for i in range(lg - 1, -1, -1):
        while power[i] <= n:
            n -= power[i]
            ans = M[i][cc].multiply(ans)
            cc += 1
            cc %= k

    result = 0
    for i in range(k + 1):
        result += ans.m[i][k]
        result %= MOD

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
